Path 1, networkingGOALS §3.4

Gateway API

The successor to Ingress, and the router a traffic-weighted canary needs.

WHAT IT IS

The Kubernetes routing API (Gateways, HTTPRoutes, GRPCRoutes) with role separation between platform and app teams and many implementations, including Istio.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Portable across implementations and expressive enough for canaries and header routing. Ingress NGINX is retired, so it's the destination, not an option.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt, with an owner and a date. It also unlocks the Argo Rollouts Gateway API plugin. On no path, but on a clock.

Ingress NGINX retirement; Gateway API maintainer track, KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT

Gateway API: The successor to Ingress, and the router a traffic-weighted canary needs. Where we stand: Adopt, with an owner and a date. It also unlocks the Argo Rollouts Gateway API plugin. On no path, but on a clock. This migration pays twice: the ingress move we have to make anyway, and the router canaries need.
